verdict.rationale: Twilio Video's own docs show event-driven automation primitives. Status Callbacks fire webhooks on Room, Recording and Composition events, and Composition Hooks are named as configurable objects with their own callback, implying rule-based automatic compositions. The pack never describes what a Composition Hook triggers or offers any general rule-definition feature, so support is thin. Missing for 10: documented rule/trigger configuration (conditions → actions), explicit description of Composition Hook behavior, any user-facing automation rules beyond webhook delivery, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Configure a `StatusCallback` URL when creating a Room using the REST API, and Twilio will make an HTTP request (webhook) to that URL whenever an event takes place in the Room.
When you create a Composition Hook, you can set the `StatusCallback` URL at such Hook.
